what_i_changed: Added `_ObservationHistory` in `gitseed/storage.py`; `SQLiteRunStore.observations()` delegates to it. It orders decoded observations by `(observed_at, observation_id)`, so backfilled runs are chronological and equal timestamps retain insert sequence. Added out-of-order/tied-timestamp coverage in `tests/test_storage.py`.
how_it_takes_the_required_approach: This uses a separate in-module history reader rather than the obvious change of modifying the existing query's `ORDER BY`. The acceptance test was not modified.
